preTriggerReconciliation: The frozen before fixture supplies a trigger in the future. The new pre-trigger head instead contains available originator-draft-saved and record-committed history, a complete signed current state/inventory, no observed supersession or rebuild event, null expiry and waiting-for-trigger. It neither schedules from that future trigger nor claims that a known trigger was absent.
atAfterReconciliation: Immediate expiry makes a record pending disposition after the earliest observed supersession/rebuild. Head-only readiness is not physical deletion or quarantine; full human/action/provider/aggregate/tombstone evidence is still required separately.
complete: Full two-copy proof graph at source +6 seconds, exact committed replay, and missing receipt control retain the original complete verifier and policy. Both orderings of the two observed trigger types are checked in the read-only profile.
profile: steer-immediate-readiness/v1; original-era RC-REBUILDABLE only, distinct from existing retention readiness and all full/current envelopes
limits: Synthetic development evidence, not a live state projection, real deletion or read-revocation transaction, qualified hold review, independent or protected acceptance. Missing future history cannot be inferred from an untrusted assertion; the complete-history/state proof is mandatory.
